$80,000-85,000 AUD annually plus superannuation
A.C.N. 656 274 501 PTY LTD T/A Spark Professional Services
Stimson St, Guildford, NSW 2161
ABN 40 656 274 501
About Us:
Spark Professional Services is a leading Australian provider of high and low-voltage electrical engineering solutions, delivering specialised services in testing, commissioning, protection systems, switching, maintenance, and engineering design. With over 15 years of industry expertise, the company supports critical infrastructure projects across data centres, mining, renewable energy, utilities, commercial and industrial facilities, and transport infrastructure sectors.
The successful candidate will contribute to the delivery of protection engineering projects including data centre switchgear systems, substations, transmission and distribution networks, and industrial power infrastructure.
Duties and Responsibilities:
1.	Analyse and interpret existing and emerging engineering technologies related to protection philosophies, single-line diagrams, and relay schematics for power system protection. 
2.	Apply technological advancements in the design, configuration, and application of protection relays and schemes. 
3.	Assist engineers in designing and developing protection schemes for electrical systems, including transformers, feeders and generators. 
4.	Configure, program, and set protection relays in accordance with coordination studies. 
5.	Perform protection coordination and grading studies to ensure selectivity and reliability of the protection system. 
6.	Troubleshoot and diagnose protection relay malfunctions, mis-operations, and scheme design issues. 
7.	Recommend modifications and improvements to protection schemes based on technical evaluations and fault analysis. 
8.	Review relay settings and protection schemes for compliance with utility, regulatory, and industry standards. 
9.	Assist in the commissioning and functional testing of protection schemes, ensuring correct relay operation and system integration. 
10.	Collaborate with testing and commissioning technologists, engineers, and technicians to integrate new protection technologies into ongoing projects. 
11.	Identify and investigate protection system failures, trips, and abnormalities, recommending corrective actions. 
12.	Perform periodic reviews and updates of protection settings to reflect system changes and load growth across client networks. 
13.	Ensure protection system designs comply with regulatory requirements, grid codes, and industry standards. 
14.	Monitor and enforce safety measures related to protection system design, settings changes, and implementation. 
15.	Prepare technical reports, protection setting sheets, coordination studies, and documentation for projects and system modifications. 
16.	Maintain accurate records of relay settings, coordination studies, protection scheme changes, and test results. 
Required Skills, Qualifications & Experience
•	Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering Technology, Electrical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline
•	Minimum 1 year of relevant industry experience in protection systems, testing, commissioning, or electrical infrastructure projects
•	Knowledge of HV/MV protection systems, protection relay testing, and commissioning practices
•	Familiarity with protection coordination, SCADA integration, and fault diagnosis within electrical networks
•	Experience using engineering and protection software such as ETAP, DigSILENT PowerFactory, or similar systems
•	Understanding of AS/NZS standards, WHS legislation, and electrical safety procedures
•	Strong analytical, technical troubleshooting, and documentation skills
•	Ability to work independently and collaboratively within project teams
•	Willingness to travel to project sites as required
•	What We Offer
•	Competitive salary package and superannuation
•	Professional development and career progression opportunities
•	Exposure to major infrastructure and electrical engineering projects
•	Supportive and technically focused working environment

About Us

Kogan People Solutions, recruiters,  is working  is a growing retail food business specialising in Korean-style fried chicken who are seeking their new Retail Manager. The business operates through takeaway, customer pickups and third-party delivery platforms, supported by state of the art integrated retail technology and digital ordering systems.

As part of their long-term growth strategy, our client is investing in scalable retail systems, operational consistency and commercial processes to support future expansion across multiple locations.

•	Location: Northcote, VIC

•	Employment Type: Full-time, ongoing

•	Salary: Negotiable in the range $80,000 – $85,000 per annum plus superannuation

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Retail Manager to oversee the commercial and operational management of our retail business. The successful candidate will be responsible for driving business performance, managing staff, coordinating inventory and purchasing activities, maintaining compliance with company policies, and implementing operational systems that improve efficiency and support business growth.

The role requires a commercially focused manager with strong leadership, financial administration and business systems experience who can optimise retail operations across multiple sites while ensuring high standards of customer service and operational performance.

Key Responsibilities

•	Manage the day-to-day operation of the retail business to achieve sales, profitability and customer service objectives. 

•	Develop and implement business strategies to improve operational efficiency, sales performance and overall profitability. 

•	Monitor sales performance, analyse trading results and prepare operational and financial reports for management. 

•	Manage retail budgets, expenses and cost control initiatives while supporting pricing and promotional strategies. 

•	Coordinate inventory management, purchasing activities and supplier relationships to ensure product availability and minimise stock losses.
 
•	Monitor stock movement and inventory records, ensuring accurate stock control and reconciliation procedures. 

•	Recruit, supervise, train and performance manage employees, including workforce planning, rostering and payroll administration using workforce management systems. 

•	Develop, implement and maintain operational procedures, policies and staff training programs to ensure consistent business practices. 

•	Ensure compliance with workplace health and safety requirements, food retail regulations, company policies and other statutory obligations. 

•	Manage customer service standards, respond to customer enquiries and resolve complaints to maintain high levels of customer satisfaction.
 
•	Coordinate the implementation and ongoing improvement of retail technology, point-of-sale systems and operational software to enhance business performance. 

•	Identify opportunities to improve business processes and support the development of systems suitable for future multi-site operations. 

Skills & Experience Required to be considered

•	Diploma or higher in Business, Management, Commerce or a closely related discipline or agreed substitute

•	At least one or more years of experience,  managing retail operations, preferably within a high-volume retail or food retail environment. 

•	Demonstrated experience in financial administration, budgeting, reporting and cost management. 

•	Experience managing inventory systems, purchasing processes and supplier relationships. 

•	Strong knowledge of retail workforce planning, payroll administration and employee supervision. 

•	Experience implementing and maintaining retail operating procedures and business systems. 

•	Sound understanding of workplace health and safety requirements and regulatory compliance. 

•	Strong analytical, organisational and problem-solving skills with the ability to make commercial decisions. 

•	Excellent leadership, communication and customer service skills. 

•	Experience using retail management software, point-of-sale systems and workforce management platforms such as Deputy is highly desirable. 

•	Valid unrestricted Victorian drivers license

You must have unrestricted rights to work full time in Australia to apply for this position. 

Why Join Us?

This is an excellent opportunity to join a growing retail business focused on innovation, operational excellence and future expansion. You will play a key role in developing scalable retail systems, improving commercial performance and supporting the continued growth of the business.

Streamair Pty Ltd is a Sydney-based specialist in the installation, servicing and maintenance of residential and commercial air conditioning systems. ## ICT Support and Test Engineers (nec)
## Position Overview
We are looking for a skilled and detail-oriented ICT Support and Test Engineer to join our team and play a key role in maintaining the integrity, performance, and quality of our systems and infrastructure. This role combines technical support, quality assurance, and systems testing to ensure seamless operations and adherence to established standards. The ideal candidate brings a methodical approach to problem-solving, strong communication skills, and a solid foundation in ICT systems and environments. This position suits an experienced professional who thrives in a collaborative setting and is committed to delivering high-quality technical outcomes.
## Key Responsibilities
- Schedule and conduct quality audit inspections across systems, data, and documentation, identifying variations and potential high-risk areas to ensure continued adherence to established standards and procedures.
- Investigate, diagnose, and resolve system problems and performance issues, providing hands-on troubleshooting support for desktops, hardware, software, printers, databases, operating systems, email platforms, and network connectivity.
- Test the functionality, behaviour, and integrity of systems and application code within defined testing protocols and quality frameworks, identifying and documenting errors, faults, and deviations from specification.
- Develop, implement, and maintain quality assurance processes, guidelines, and strategies to support system reliability, security, and performance across the organisation.
- Recommend and facilitate corrective action plans to address non-compliance issues identified through ongoing monitoring, auditing, and review of operational processes and procedures.
- Perform organisational systems architecture reviews and assessments, providing well-informed recommendations on current and future hardware and software strategies aligned with business needs.
- Develop and deliver technical guidance, training, and support to end users and stakeholders on application software, operational procedures, and best practice usage.
- Communicate and liaise effectively with users and management to promote awareness of quality control standards, data integrity requirements, and ICT compliance obligations.
- Create, review, and maintain comprehensive technical documentation including procedural guides, operational manuals, technical specifications, testing reports, and maintenance inventory records.
- Assist in the planning and execution of system upgrades, installations, configurations, and patch management activities to minimise disruption and maintain system availability.
- Monitor and evaluate system infrastructure to proactively identify risks and opportunities for improvement, contributing to the ongoing optimisation of ICT environments.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams and project stakeholders to support the delivery of ICT initiatives and ensure quality outcomes are achieved throughout the project lifecycle.
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- A bachelor's degree or diploma in Information Technology, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline; or equivalent demonstrated experience in a similar ICT role.
- Proven experience in ICT technical support, systems testing, or quality assurance within a professional environment.
- Strong understanding of testing methodologies, quality assurance frameworks, and audit processes across systems and software.
- Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues across a broad range of ICT systems, including hardware, software, operating systems, and network components.
- Experience developing and maintaining technical documentation such as test plans, procedural guides, specifications, and operational manuals.
- Solid knowledge of database management, system security, backup procedures, and infrastructure performance monitoring.
- Proficiency in diagnosing software and hardware faults and delivering appropriate solutions within agreed timeframes and service levels.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a structured, methodical approach to quality assurance and issue resolution.
- Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to convey technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
- Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team, managing competing priorities and deadlines effectively.
## Preferred Qualifications
- Relevant industry certifications such as ITIL Foundation, CompTIA A+, CompTIA Network+, ISTQB (Software Testing), or Microsoft Certified qualifications.
- Experience with enterprise-level systems, cloud platforms, or virtualisation technologies such as AWS, Azure, or VMware.
- Familiarity with IT service management (ITSM) tools such as ServiceNow, Jira, or Zendesk.
- Exposure to Agile or DevOps delivery environments and associated testing practices such as continuous integration and automated testing.
- Previous experience conducting formal ICT audits, architecture reviews, or compliance assessments.
- Knowledge of relevant Australian and international ICT standards and frameworks, including ISO/IEC 27001 or COBIT.
## Why Join Us?
- Be part of a collaborative, forward-thinking team that values innovation, continuous improvement, and professional growth.
- Access ongoing learning and development opportunities, including support for professional certifications and industry training.
- Enjoy a flexible work environment with options for hybrid working arrangements to support work-life balance.
- Contribute to meaningful, large-scale ICT projects that have a real impact on organisational performance and service delivery.
- Competitive salary package with opportunities for career progression within a growing and dynamic technology function.
## Job Details
- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Super
